identity.name: Presage Cocktail Time

case.bezel: none — dress case, box-shaped Hardlex crystal

identity.one_liner: The ice-blue sunburst version of Seiko's Presage Cocktail Time, its dial finish styled after the layered gloss of a mixed drink.

provenance_events.description: The Presage "Cocktail Time" SRPB43 — designed with a textured dial that mimics a cocktail glass — becomes the most-cited Seiko Presage reference among enthusiasts for its 40.5mm case, 4R36 movement, and 50m water resistance at an attainable price.

narrative.story: The SRPB43 is the ice-blue sunburst-dial version of Seiko's Presage Cocktail Time line, running caliber 4R35 — a 23-jewel automatic with roughly 41 hours of reserve — in a 40.5mm case under a box-shaped Hardlex crystal. The Cocktail Time name and dial style reference Japan's bartending culture, translating the layered gloss finish of a mixed drink into a sunburst dial pattern. It ships on a leather strap rather than the metal bracelet used on some other Presage lines.
narrative.collector_notes: Currently listed as sold out on Seiko's own US site rather than formally discontinued; check current retailer stock before assuming it's off the market for good.
